title: Tensor-variable associativity of the specified system projection maps
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$ of characteristic $p$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, and put $A_n=R/\varpi^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $h:U\to V$ be a separated finite-type morphism of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. On their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let $\mathscr N_T\subset D(\mathscr S_T)$ be the category of normalized strict semilinear $((A_n)_T)_n$-systems whose levels lie in $D^b_{ctf}(T,A_n)$, with no common bound required, as defined in [lem-coef-finite-adjunction-diagram-realization]. Use its specified compact-support realization $F_h$ and the simultaneous derived tensor and pullback models of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Let
$$P_{h,M,L}:F_hM\otimes L\longrightarrow F_h(M\otimes h^*L)$$
be the specified system projection map of [lem-pur-system-level-projection-formula-coherence, def-exchange-projection], constructed from the proper direct-image counit projection mate and the open-extension tensor comparison in a compactification. For inputs where $P_{h,M,L}$ is invertible, put
$$Q_{h,L,M}=s_{F_hM,L}\,P_{h,M,L}^{-1}\,F_h(s_{h^*L,M}):F_h(h^*L\otimes M)\longrightarrow L\otimes F_hM,$$
where $s_{A,B}:A\otimes B\to B\otimes A$ is the canonical derived tensor symmetry. For $L,L'\in\mathscr N_V$ and $M\in\mathscr N_U$, assume that all displayed tensor objects lie in these categories. Then, with no invertibility assumption,
$$P_{h,M,L'\otimes L}=P_{h,M\otimes h^*L',L}\,(P_{h,M,L'}\otimes1_L):F_hM\otimes L'\otimes L\longrightarrow F_h(M\otimes h^*(L'\otimes L)),$$
using the canonical associators and the canonical pullback tensor comparison $h^*(L'\otimes L)\simeq h^*L'\otimes h^*L$. Moreover, if $P_{h,M,L'}$ and $P_{h,h^*L'\otimes M,L}$ are invertible, then $P_{h,M,L\otimes L'}$ is invertible and
$$Q_{h,L\otimes L',M}=(1_L\otimes Q_{h,L',M})\,Q_{h,L,h^*L'\otimes M}.$$
This equation uses the canonical pullback tensor comparison $h^*(L\otimes L')\simeq h^*L\otimes h^*L'$ on the source and canonical associators and symmetries on source and target. It is an equality in the derived category of strict systems before total inverse limit, for the specified simultaneous maps, not an inference from equality of arbitrary finite evaluations. No exceptional right adjoint or cohomological smoothness is assumed.
